tools.name: replatform_get_engagement
tools.title: Get Replatform engagement
tools.description: Read one integrated engagement after tenant, customer, solution, and principal scope checks. Returns metadata only; it cannot confirm a zone or change state.

tools.name: replatform_get_audit_timeline
tools.title: Get safe Replatform audit timeline
tools.description: Read up to 500 validated engagement events, including human-recorded answers and lifecycle metadata. Raw event payloads, source contents, and secrets are never returned.

tools.name: replatform_get_policy_snapshot
tools.title: Get Replatform policy snapshot
tools.description: Read the immutable policy snapshot bound to one in-scope engagement. This does not change policy or approve a plan.

tools.name: replatform_get_landing_zone_catalog
tools.title: Get redacted landing-zone catalog
tools.description: Read the redacted policy catalog only. It contains no customer resource names, credentials, or approval decisions.

tools.name: replatform_discover_azure_landing_zone
tools.title: Discover connected Azure landing-zone metadata
tools.description: Read inventory metadata only for the connected subscriptions of an in-scope engagement that explicitly allows read-only Azure discovery. No Azure access is attempted when the engagement permission is none; no resource changes, secret values, customer source, or raw logs are read.

tools.name: replatform_allowed_source_connections
tools.title: List allowed source connections
tools.description: List the already-approved active source connection for one in-scope engagement. Returns target and immutable revision metadata only, never credentials or source contents.

tools.name: replatform_get_customer_caf_profile
tools.title: Get the customer's CAF profile
tools.description: Read the CAF profile of the customer that owns one in-scope solution: the networks, regions and policies a landing zone must fit. Facts only, no credentials; a key for one solution cannot read another customer's profile.

tools.name: replatform_get_engagement_input
tools.title: Get the Wizard's answers for this engagement
tools.description: Read what the Wizard already knows about one in-scope solution (contract C1): customer, tenant, zone, region, archetype, connectivity, audience, environments with their subscriptions, and the newest source upload with its SHA. Start here and ask the owner only for the fields listed in `missing`. Names, choices and hashes only; no credentials and no source content.

tools.name: replatform_get_shared_resources
tools.title: Get shared platform resources
tools.description: Read the latest inventory of itm8's shared platform resources that a new solution could reuse before it creates its own. Names and kinds only; nothing is created or resized.

tools.name: replatform_get_prerequisite_status
tools.title: Get the customer's prerequisite status
tools.description: Read, for one in-scope solution, which customer prerequisites it has: the question packages issued to the customer's role-holders (platform, identity, SOC, DNS and mail, CI/CD) with their recorded status (issued, sent, verified, waived and so on), gate (open, verified, waived, excluded) and how each was closed (read, attested, waived), or, before any is issued, the DNS records, TLS certificate and mail sender its specification implies (tracking 'derived'). Each has its owner role and the role that blocks it, plus the customer roles that have no active holder and whether the prerequisites that hold the deployment are cleared. Role names and flags only: no contact names or emails, no artefact text, no link tokens. It never creates, sends, verifies, waives or closes a package; use it to say 'blocked on the customer's DNS admin'.

tools.name: replatform_validate_replatform_plan
tools.title: Validate a Replatform assessment without storing it
tools.description: Run the checks a posted assessment passes (report scope, target plan binding, model placement against the AI policy, evidence for every claim) and return the refusal reasons. Nothing is stored.

tools.name: replatform_post_replatform_assessment
tools.title: Post a Replatform assessment
tools.description: Store a draft assessment for one in-scope solution after the same checks as validate. It starts as proposed; only a person accepts it. No source, issue, pull request or Azure resource is changed.

tools.name: replatform_register_evidence
tools.title: Register evidence metadata
tools.description: Register a hash, classification, safe pointer, and redacted summary. Raw files, source contents, prompts, and secret values are not accepted or stored.

tools.name: replatform_register_artifact
tools.title: Register artifact metadata
tools.description: Register a hash and redacted artifact summary with an optional safe log pointer. The artifact itself and any secret values are not accepted or stored.

tools.name: replatform_append_event
tools.title: Append bounded Replatform event
tools.description: Append one typed delegation, validation-result, or classified-error event. Arbitrary event payloads and raw logs are not accepted.

tools.name: replatform_ask_question
tools.title: Request owner clarification
tools.description: Request a human clarification with an optional list of in-scope evidence IDs. An agent may ask; only a human caller may record the answer.

tools.name: replatform_answer_question
tools.title: Record owner clarification
tools.description: Record a human answer to a previously requested clarification. Human caller only; evidence references must belong to this engagement.

tools.name: replatform_answer_risk_question
tools.title: Record evidence-backed risk answer
tools.description: Record an evidence-referenced assessment answer. Unknown answers require an unavailable reason; this is not an owner approval or zone confirmation.

tools.name: replatform_request_approval
tools.title: Request human plan review
tools.description: Move an eligible assessment to awaiting human review. This requests approval only; it never approves a plan, confirms a zone, grants access, or deploys.

tools.name: replatform_record_approval
tools.title: Record authorized human decision
tools.description: Record an approval or rejection through the existing authorized human control-plane path. Available only to fleet decision authorities and only in the valid review state.

tools.name: replatform_request_scope_amendment
tools.title: Request scope amendment
tools.description: Request a human review of proposed engagement scope changes. Human caller only; this does not modify the existing engagement.

tools.name: replatform_decide_scope_amendment
tools.title: Decide scope amendment request
tools.description: Record an authorized human decision for a previously requested amendment. Available only to fleet decision authorities; it does not mutate the original engagement.

tools.name: replatform_get_customer_summary
tools.title: Get the customer summary
tools.description: Read, for one in-scope solution, its customer, the estate check (management group, policy, hub network, firewall, DNS, Log Analytics, Sentinel, Key Vault, subscriptions) with where each fact came from (read, observed, answered or unknown) and what was found or why it is unknown, and for each customer role whether it has an active holder. Role names and flags only: no contact names, emails or languages, and not who recorded a fact. Use it to say what is unknown and which role can answer it.

tools.name: replatform_post_wizard_proposal
tools.title: Propose apps and answers for the Wizard's steps
tools.description: Store a proposal for the Apps step of one in-scope solution (contract C2 with source wizard-agent), with optional answers for steps 1 to 3 and the readiness step (`steps`: tenant, region, allowed regions, zone, archetype, connectivity, audience, environments, ownership mode, source origin, write mode; never contacts, evidence references or readiness attestations), recorded against the newest saved Wizard answers. It is never a final value: the Wizard answers, the specification and ai-factory.json stay as they are until a person applies the proposal and approves the settings. Names and paths only; a value that looks like a secret is refused. The same proposal sent twice is stored once.

tools.name: replatform_create_question_packages
tools.title: Create the question packages
tools.description: Create the question packages for the customer's role-holders from the approved specification of one in-scope solution, as staff do on the solution page: an unchanged package stays, a changed one is superseded. It acts for the staff member who issued the key and needs an approved specification. It never sends, verifies, attests, waives or closes a package; a person sends them. Read the result with replatform_get_prerequisite_status.

tools.name: replatform_start_replatform_run
tools.title: Start a Replatform run
tools.description: Start the GitHub run of one in-scope engagement whose repository a person approved, or return the run it already has: the same run the staff page and the A2A facade start. It acts for the staff member who issued the key. It never approves a plan, confirms a zone, merges or deploys. Refused while agent-started runs are switched off.

tools.name: replatform_get_replatform_run
tools.title: Get a Replatform run
tools.description: Read the run of one in-scope engagement: its state, the pull request link, the newest assessment, the Replatform agent's typed app proposal (C2) for the Wizard and the steps a person still has to take. Ids, states and links only. Refused while agent-started runs are switched off.
